comment: Cheap independent variation of the Conflict monster-to-monster sleep path: gnome Wizard and a hostile kobold, with a hostile homunculus as the AD_SLEE attacker. The frozen C trace (run-kjAXtK) shows the first positive M-to-M call at boundary 110: C-generated jackal is the actual defender, and mhitm_ad_slee consumes rnd(10)=6 then rnd(10)=7; the first call freezes it, so the second returns false. The 15 source-bounded turn opportunities end at this observed call, not at a JavaScript-selected point. Source path: mon.c:movemon_singlemon -> mhitm.c:fightm -> mhitm.c:mattackm -> uhitm.c:mhitm_ad_slee.
